summary.text: Tony D'Arrigo is running with no party affiliation for Florida's 13th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a hospitality business consultant and owner of an entertainment business based in the Tampa area.

paragraphs.text: D'Arrigo was born in Hackensack, New Jersey, and raised in Brigantine, New Jersey. He earned a high school diploma from Atlantic City High School and moved to Tampa, Florida, in 2014.
He has worked as a hospitality business management consultant and is the owner and operator of Two Step Entertainment.
According to his candidate questionnaire, he is a small business owner who has spent his career in hospitality management, and he is a published author.
